display_name: A6 curved footed glass with white ceramic saucer

design.geometry: compact wide oval rim, inward waist, rounded lower bowl and short narrow glass foot; centered on a broad low circular saucer approximately 1.55 times the glass width
components: broad low round white ceramic saucer

allowed_transfer: glass material and curved footed silhouette
rim, waist, rounded bowl and short foot geometry
the complete white ceramic saucer and the glass-on-saucer support relation
forbidden_transfer: reference coffee, cream, cocoa, color layers, garnish or toppings
reference text, logo, watermark or decorative brand mark
reference heater, plants, furniture, background, tray layout or exact shadow silhouette

compatibility.brand_surface: plain unobstructed front glass only; the saucer never receives branding
